headline: Trump threatens tax or ban on US firms building data centers abroad
summary: President Trump said companies would face a "tremendous tax" for building data centers outside the US, and separately said he would not allow US companies to build them abroad. Tom's Hardware reports companies could instead pay a hefty fee to build overseas. The BBC notes Trump gave little detail, and The Register says analysts question how the restrictions would work.
